The symptoms of a spinning room, nausea, and vomiting with sudden onset strongly suggest a vestibular issue rather than a gastrointestinal one. Please tell me, does the spinning sensation stop completely when you keep your head still and close your eyes?

speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The normal audiometry results rule out inner ear infections or sensorineural hearing loss, and since the spinning sensation is triggered by head movement, this points strongly to displaced otoconia in the semicircular canals. Are you experiencing any hearing loss, tinnitus, or double vision along with the vertigo?
